help.title: 帮助与危机热线
help.subtitle: 你不是一个人。在这里找到即时支持。
help.meta_description: 全球免费、匿名的 LGBTQIA+ 危机热线和咨询服务。你不是一个人。
help.emergency_body: 请立即拨打急救电话：112（欧盟）或 911（美国/加拿大）。分秒必争。
help.disclaimer: Queer Guide 不能替代专业帮助。
help.no_results: 没有匹配的热线。试试所有国家或查看国际目录。
help.error_body: 如遇紧急危险，请拨打当地急救电话：112（欧盟）或 911（美国/加拿大）。
help.quick_exit_aria: 立即离开此页面（Esc 键）
help.reveal_aria: 点击任意位置可重新显示页面
help.hidden_hint: 页面已隐藏。点击任意位置可重新显示。
help.expect_1: You'll hear a short greeting. You don't have to give your name.
help.expect_2: You can hang up at any time. You can call back as often as you need.
help.expect_3: Free hotlines in DE/AT/CH don't appear on itemized phone bills.
help.expect_4: If you can't speak, ask for text or chat — most hotlines offer it.
help.self_help_desc: Short techniques you can use while you wait, or instead of a call if you're not ready.
help.breathing_1: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds.
help.breathing_3: Breathe out through your mouth for 8 seconds.
help.grounding_intro: Name, out loud or in your head:
help.safety_plan_desc: A short written plan you can pull up when things get bad — your warning signs, coping steps, people to call, and reasons to live.
help.report_aria: Report a problem with this hotline
help.report_desc: Thanks for helping keep this list accurate. Reports are reviewed by our team.
help.closed_no_alt: 该热线现在不在服务时间，本国也没有其他正在开放的热线。如有紧急危险，请拨打上方的紧急号码。
help.directories_subtitle: 这些是转介机构和名录——是网站，而不是可直接通话的热线。
help.helping_body: 如果你正在陪伴一个处于危机中的人：留在他身边，认真对待他所说的话，不要让他独自一人。你不需要知道所有答案。可以一起拨打热线，也可以自己打电话询问接下来该怎么做。
help.know_the_law_body: 能否安全地公开身份、就医或报警，取决于你所在的地方。采取行动前请先了解当地的法律状况。
help.link_unavailable: 该网站暂时无法访问，正在重新核查。
help.no_country_body: 在上方选择国家，我们会显示最合适的热线。下方列出了我们收录的全部热线。
help.no_country_title: 我们无法确定你所在的位置
help.no_lines_body: 如果你此刻身处危险，请拨打紧急电话：112（欧盟）或 911（美国/加拿大）。
help.no_police_policy: 该热线明确承诺，未经你本人明确请求，绝不联系警方或急救服务。
help.open_instead: 现在可联系的其他热线
help.org_coverage: 这份名录远未覆盖所有地区。如果缺少你信任的机构，请告诉我们。结果为空只说明我们没有收录，并不代表没有帮助。
help.phone_only: 据我们掌握的信息，仅提供电话服务。
help.phone_only_with_site: 据我们掌握的信息，仅提供电话服务。其网站上可能有在线聊天或电子邮件。
help.reports_police_warning: 该热线可能在未经你同意的情况下联系警方或急救服务。
help.scope_all: 显示我们收录的所有国家的热线。
help.scope_dialog_desc: 热线按其服务的国家排列。无论选择哪个国家，国际名录都会保持显示。
help.support_orgs_body: 提供面对面支持的社群中心和公益组织。

hidden-lives.title: [ZH] Hidden lives
hidden-lives.intro: 1800 年以前，酷儿的生活在法律与教会的阴影下存续。留在记录里的多半是迫害：审判、处决、敕令。与之并存的，是少数比它们活得更久的爱与社群的痕迹。

empire-criminalization.title: [ZH] Empire & criminalization
empire-criminalization.intro: [ZH] Colonial empires exported sodomy laws across the globe in the 19th century, while a few states — revolutionary France first among them — quietly removed their own. Much of today's legal map was drawn in this era.

birth-of-movement.title: [ZH] Birth of a movement
birth-of-movement.intro: [ZH] Between the 1860s and the early 1930s the first words, organizations and campaigns emerged: Kertbeny coined 'homosexual', Hirschfeld founded the first gay rights organization, and Berlin briefly became the queer capital of the world.

destruction.title: [ZH] Destruction
destruction.intro: [ZH] Fascism destroyed the first movement. The Nazis burned Hirschfeld's institute, tightened Paragraph 175 and deported thousands of gay men to concentration camps. Remembering this era is part of why this timeline exists.

homophile-years.title: [ZH] The homophile years
homophile-years.intro: 战后，小型「同性恋权益」团体悄然重建：马塔辛、比利提斯的女儿、阿卡迪、COC。它们以激进换取体面，而突击搜查与清洗仍在继续。

liberation.title: [ZH] Liberation
liberation.intro: [ZH] Stonewall in 1969 turned decades of quiet organizing into open revolt. Pride marches spread worldwide, homosexuality left the psychiatric manuals, and the first anti-discrimination laws were won.

aids-crisis.title: [ZH] The AIDS crisis
aids-crisis.intro: 在政府别过头去的时候，整整一代人被夺走。这场疫病的悲痛锻造出重塑医学与酷儿政治的抗争行动：ACT UP，以及争取治疗可及性的运动。

recognition.title: [ZH] Recognition
recognition.intro: [ZH] From the first registered partnerships to the Netherlands opening marriage in 2001, courts and parliaments began recognizing queer lives: decriminalization accelerated and trans rights entered the legal mainstream.

equality-wave.title: [ZH] The equality wave
equality-wave.intro: [ZH] The 2010s brought marriage equality to dozens of countries on every continent, landmark court rulings from the United States to India, and unprecedented queer visibility in public life.

backlash-now.title: [ZH] Backlash & now
backlash-now.intro: [ZH] Progress continues — and so does organized backlash: 'LGBT-free zones', anti-trans legislation and new criminalization drives. The timeline is still being written.

sources.title: [ZH] Where this data comes from
sources.lede: [ZH] We publish the legal status of LGBTQ+ people in every country and territory we cover. This page says who recorded it, how often we refresh it, how much of it we actually hold, and the questions it cannot answer.
sources.metaTitle: [ZH] Where our LGBTQ+ rights data comes from
sources.metaDescription: [ZH] The sources, refresh cadence, coverage and known limits behind the legal status we publish for every country and territory.

section.limits: [ZH] What this data cannot tell you

kicker.score: [ZH] How it is built, and what it hides

coverage.status: [ZH] Countries with a recorded legal status

body.source: 本站的每一项法律状态都来自 ILGA World Database，即国际女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋、跨性别与间性者协会维护的基准数据集。涵盖刑事化、伴侣关系承认、反歧视保护、性别承认、扭转治疗，以及间性者的身体完整权。
body.refresh: [ZH] We re-import it nightly. Where a country page shows an "Updated" date, that is the date ILGA last revised that record, not the date we fetched it.
body.unscored: [ZH] The unscored rows are uninhabited or near-uninhabited territories with no ILGA entry. We list them as "not scored" rather than giving them a default, because a default would read as a measurement.
body.scoreHow: [ZH] The score runs 0–100. It starts at 50 and moves up or down as each recorded right is added: decriminalisation and marriage weigh heaviest, then anti-discrimination protections, hate-crime law, adoption, legal gender recognition and a conversion-therapy ban.
body.scoreLimit: [ZH] Because it opens at 50 and adds from there, a country we hold almost nothing about lands mid-scale rather than reading as unknown. A middling score can mean middling rights or thin data, and the number cannot tell you which.
body.scoreLens: [ZH] It is also a single number for very different lives. Protections are recorded separately for sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression and sex characteristics, and those four rarely move together — a country can protect sexual orientation thoroughly and gender identity not at all. Read the per-right breakdown on a country page rather than the score alone.
body.scoreNotSafety: [ZH] The score describes law on paper. It is not a safety rating, and it says nothing about enforcement, policing or how welcome you will be made to feel.

limits.national: 数据以国家为单位。在美国、印度尼西亚、尼日利亚、墨西哥这类权利因州或省而异的地方，单一的全国数字会把差异抹平。
limits.enforcement: [ZH] It records statutes, not enforcement. A law that is rarely applied and a law applied constantly look identical here.
limits.trans: [ZH] Several facts that matter most to trans travellers are not in this dataset at all: bathroom and facility access, how identity documents are treated at borders, and access to gender-affirming healthcare.
limits.personal: [ZH] It knows nothing about you. Your citizenship, residency, gender marker and relationship status all change what applies, and we hold none of them.
limits.corrections: [ZH] If something here is wrong, tell us — corrections to the underlying record should also go to ILGA, who maintain it.

story.title: 这一切怎么开始的
story.p1: 找一家对酷儿友好的酒吧，不该需要一个群聊、三个论坛帖子和一点运气。我们做 Queer Guide，是因为受够了猜哪些地方真的安全——以及哪些只是在六月给标志加了道彩虹。
story.p2: 一份私人的可信场所清单，变成了一个全球目录：由社群核实，基于真实经历，永久免费。独自旅行、搬到新城市，或只是想找个周五晚上待着的地方——从这里开始。

verified.label: 社群核实
verified.body: 每一个场所都由真实的 LGBTQ+ 人士审核，而不是算法。

safety.label: 安全优先
safety.body: 每个国家页面都标注当地法律、权利与风险提示。

free.label: 永远免费
free.body: 没有付费墙，没有会员等级。这个平台属于所有人。

global.label: 覆盖全球
global.body: 从柏林到曼谷，从圣保罗到悉尼——还在不断扩展。

history.title: 目前的线路
history.lede: 一个副业项目，长成了全球目录。

y2021.body: 三个人，一张表格。五座欧洲城市的安全酒吧，分享在一个 Telegram 群里。

y2023.body: 八十座城市、一千个场所。活动收录流程和社群提交扩展上线。

y2025.body: 各大洲数以万计的场所。市集、行程规划、安全简报，以及逐国的权利资料。

y2026.body: 你在这里。添加一个场所、发布一场活动，或加入内容共建者。

inclusivity.title: 包容
inclusivity.description: 每一种身份、每一种背景、每一段经历，都属于这里。

safety.title: 安全
safety.description: 线上线下都要安全。这排在其他一切之前。

community.title: 社群
community.description: 人与支持他们的组织之间，真实的连接。

authenticity.title: 真实
authenticity.description: 做你自己。我们建这个地方，就是为了让你不必躲藏。

accessibility.title: 无障碍
accessibility.description: 我们标注无台阶入口与无障碍卫生间，以及缺少什么。

growth.title: 成长
growth.description: 一直在变，一直在听。建立在你们告诉我们的事情之上。

people.title: 背后的人
people.lede: 没有公司。只有拿出时间的社群成员。

moderators.name: 社群审核员
moderators.description: 志愿者全天候维护平台的友善与尊重。

ambassadors.name: 本地大使
ambassadors.description: 社群中的组织者，把本地需求带上来，并为所在地区的包容空间发声。

contributors.name: 共建者
contributors.description: 撰写评价、发布活动、搭建资料的成员——其他人都靠这些。

cta.title: 帮我们把线路延长。
cta.body: 网络之所以生长，是因为有人不断添砖加瓦。每一条核实过的记录背后都有一个人——加上你的那一条。

addVenues.title: 添加场所
addVenues.desc: 知道哪里安全？把它标到地图上。

joinGroups.title: 加入小组
joinGroups.desc: 这场对话里有你的位置。

support.title: 支持我们
support.desc: 让平台对所有人保持免费。

hanky.title: 暗号
hanky.intro: 后裤袋里的彩色手帕曾用来示意特定的兴趣——左袋代表给予方，右袋代表接受方。此处按 1980 年代出版的版本记录；含义因城市和年代而异。
hanky.safeMode: 颜色表涉及露骨的性实践，安全模式开启时将隐藏。
hanky.gateBody: 颜色表列出了露骨的性实践。请确认你已年满 18 岁再阅读。
hanky.disclaimer: 仅为历史参考，并非对任何实践的认可。流传的颜色还有数十种；没有两份公开列表完全一致。
